milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the lava pool (centered at ~7,0,7 spawn-relative) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the lava.

Uses inventory_has because mining sand causes it to drop as an item which enters the player's inventory. Sand drops itself when mined by any tool or hand. The player starts with no sand in inventory, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The gray stained glass tower is centered at approximately (-8, 4, -7) spawn-relative on the red sandstone pyramid. The player must navigate close enough and face toward it. max_distance=16 allows spotting from a reasonable distance, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the glass beacon.

Uses inventory_has because mining red sandstone with a pickaxe causes it to drop as an item which enters the player's inventory. Red sandstone requires any pickaxe tier to mine (iron pickaxe is provided). The player starts with no red sandstone, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining.
